_note: Independent reproduction of the CASCADE (shipped) arm. The manuscript previously quoted 9% premature-flag and 0.033 mean pre-onset probability from an untracked measurement; neither is reproduced here under any tested definition (operating threshold: 0.020; argmax: 0.033; fixed day-11 cut: 0.013). The shipped model measures BETTER than the previously quoted figure. The 'before' (no-cascade) arm requires a model trained without truncation augmentation and is a separate training run.
